_doc: Stream P-core (round 8, W9 Professions) — MADE by tools/content-professions.mjs (the marks follow the bake); edit the text in the tool. The first meeting: Bram Delver, a prospector just inside Torborhold's main gate, teaches Mining the moment you speak to him (and hands over a pick); his chain walks you to the copper, the smith's forge and the tempering gauge. Step kinds gather / craft / learn are js/sim/quests.js (W9).

prospector_torborhold.name: Bram Delver
prospector_torborhold.greeting: See the boulders with green in them, out past the gate? That is copper, and it is yours for the price of three good swings.

quests.name: Three Good Swings
quests.offer: New boots, clean hands. You want work that pays? That pick I just gave you is yours. Walk out of the gate and look for boulders with green lumps sticking out: copper. Three swings each. Hit when the marker crosses the bright spot, not before, not after.

steps.where: the ore boulders by the road just outside Torborhold's gate

steps.text: Show Bram what you dug out
steps.where: Bram Delver, just inside Torborhold's main gate

quests.done: That is ore, that is. A clean strike sometimes shakes a stone loose too: sell those dear. The boulders fill again for you in a few minutes, and nobody else can empty yours.
quests.rewardText: The Prospector's Pick is yours to keep, with a crate from the last fellow who never came back for it.

quests.name: Bronze, Not Copper
quests.offer: Copper alone bends like a spoon. Smelt it with tin and you have bronze. The grey boulders are tin. Take three of each to Garrow at the smithy, ask him to teach you Smithing, and use his fire: three bars, then hammer yourself a blade. Strike while the bar glows in the band. Too cold? Back in the fire.

steps.text: Ask the smith to teach you Smithing
Smelt 3 Bronze Bars at the forge (1 Copper Ore + 1 Tin Ore each)
Forge a bronze blade (3 Bronze Bars)

steps.where: Bram Delver, just inside Torborhold's main gate

quests.done: You made that? With those hands? Well. It will not win prizes, but it is yours, and the next one will be better: the steadier your hammer, the better the blade comes out.
quests.rewardText: Coin for the ore you burned, a crate of armour, and Bram's grudging respect.

quests.name: An Edge on It
quests.offer: One more trick. A smith can TEMPER a thing you already own: better quality, a new property, never a ruined blade. Ask Garrow to teach you Tempering, put your new blade in your bag, and stop the gauge inside the band. It costs two bars and a little coin. Miss, and you lose the bars. Never the blade.

steps.text: Ask the smith to teach you Tempering
Temper any weapon or armour piece from your bag

steps.where: Bram Delver, just inside Torborhold's main gate

quests.done: There. Now you know the whole road: dig it, smelt it, forge it, temper it. The tailor, the bowyer and the apothecary teach the other trades, and every one of them pays.
quests.rewardText: A crate with a weapon in it, to practise your tempering on.
